# Reporting Security Issues

To report a security issue or vulnerability in these actions, please use the confidential GitHub Security Advisory ["Report a Vulnerability"](https://github.com/zarf-dev/actions/security/advisories) tab. The Zarf team will send a response indicating the next steps in handling your report. After the initial reply to your report, the team will keep you informed of the progress towards a fix and full announcement, and may ask for additional information or guidance.

### When Should I Report a Vulnerability?

* You found a way for an action in this repository to leak a token or secret, run untrusted code, or pass a check it should fail.
* You found a vulnerability in a dependency of an action that affects it and has not been patched yet.

### When Should I NOT Report a Vulnerability?

* You found a bug or malfunction in an action (not security related).
* You want to add a feature or a new action.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest commit on `main` is supported. Repositories that pin an action to an older commit should update to pick up fixes.

## Contacting Us

To discuss security related issues, please email the maintainers at zarf-dev-private@googlegroups.com.
